data.evidence_sentence: Awarded annually to a full-time student entering their second year of studies in the Alberta School of Business MBA Program.
data.notes: The 3.3 GPA is required after completing first-year MBA studies, so it is treated as a condition for the award, not a renewal rule. Term is Fall. Selection is based on extra-curricular involvement and personal growth, which is a preference, not a hard criterion. No deadline, funding amount, or nationality rule is stated. Host country taken from the university name and URL.
